Hello Creators!

Remember last year when**CONNECT** partnered with the **KOFOTI(Korea Federation of Textile Industries)** to provide 500 free block patterns?  
Creators widely used them in their projects, and the response was amazing!

This year, we’re offering an additional [**300 NEW BLOCK PATTERNS!**](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/208988/collection/collections)**

**💡 How can you use these patterns?**

These patterns can be applied directly to your modeling without starting from scratch, saving you significant time while still producing high-quality results.  
Plus, they are free for commercial use, so they’re perfect for both personal and professional projects.  
  


**⚡ Work smarter, efficient and faster**

These patterns can be used from modeling all the way to physical production, offering versatile applications for your projects.

title: royal robe
content:
I designed this medieval-inspired ceremonial robe to explore a blend of regal silhouettes, rich velvet textures, and intricate gold ornament details.

My goal was to recreate the majestic presence of ancient royal garments while keeping the structure clean and optimized for 3D workflows, game characters, and cinematic projects.

Created entirely in CLO3D

I’d love to hear your thoughts

![e697e477f07c4c90977688dada44abd7](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/e4b61331dc7f4b4d803b528f8d553d35/images/e697e477f07c4c90977688dada44abd7preview%2003.png)3D Artist: Zeinab Dahgani

Portfolio: [www.cv.zeinabdahgani.com](http://www.cv.zeinabdahgani.com)

Email: best3dmodeling@gmail.com

instagram: <https://www.instagram.com/zeinab_dahgani/>

LinkedIn : <https://www.linkedin.com/in/zeinab-dahgani>


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: This is legit!!
Reply 1: Thanks a lot! Glad you think so!😍

Comment 2: The level of detail here is impressive. The fabric choice and ornaments feel so realistic. Great job!😍
Reply 1: thanks🙏🏻

Comment 3: This looks incredible! The details and the velvet texture are stunning. Really curious to see more of your work—please keep sharing!
Reply 1: Thank you so much! I’m really glad you liked the details and textures. I’m working on a few new pieces and will share them soon!🙏🏻

Comment 4: I’d be really happy to hear your thoughts and feedback on this design. Your comments help me improve and create better pieces. Feel free to share any ideas or critiques!
content_description: Explore the majestic blend of regal design and modern efficiency in this medieval-inspired ceremonial robe, crafted for 3D workflows and cinematic projects.

title: 🎉 EveryWear is back with even more powerful features!
content:
## ![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/7e3a228809674d1797b38287c7ab59e8/images/974986754bc24634a4e8d744f62dca07Community%20thumbnail_re.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/7e3a228809674d1797b38287c7ab59e8/images/a805f6c2e1c64dbc8febf0a4c5554156Community%20thumbnail_re.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/7e3a228809674d1797b38287c7ab59e8/images/32b295b3214a4f499a69dba2c570e1b6Community%20thumbnail.png)  
**_🎉 EveryWear is back with even more powerful features!_**

  
Along with **CLO/Marvelous Designer 2025.2** , a new tutorial video for EveryWear has been released, showing how creators can connect their digital garments to various avatars and digital spaces.

* * *

In this tutorial, you can explore the upgraded EveryWear**key features** :

  
✨ **Key Features  
Local Export  
Bind Pose  
Target Joint  
Copy Symmetric Weights  
Auto Seal**

* * *

How’s that? Much easier to optimize than before, right?  
  
✨ And there’s even more to explore. Discover additional features and workflow tips throughout the full tutorial!  
  
Plus! Check out inZOI game outfits made with EveryWear   
directly on [GAMEWEAR](https://connect.clo-set.com/gamewear/inzoi).

  
Follow along step by step, and if you have any questions or run into any issues, feel free to reach out anytime via the CONNECT community Q&A board.

* * *

  


  


**** Notice ****  
This tutorial is CLO version, and the Marvelous Designer version   
is scheduled to be uploaded in December.

**Please note that EveryWear in Marvelous Designer works the same  
as in CLO, so you can safely follow the CLO tutorial in the meantime.**

* * *

Watch now and connect your digital garments to various digital environments instantly.  
  
CONNECT supports your creative journey!
content_description: Explore the powerful new features of EveryWear in CLO/Marvelous Designer 2025.2 through our comprehensive tutorial, designed to enhance your digital garment creation and optimization experience.

title: 🎮 CONNECT x inZOI Gamewear — Now Open to Creators!
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/bc462714126240ce9817aed6ad9d773b/images/a8916eee3d024aa5b7e56d1fc23cef89Social%20Media_Square_B.png)**We’re excited to open the inZOI Gamewear Store!**  
  
You now have **access** to upload inZOI Character Custom Content directly on CONNECT. Join the **Gamewear Creator Benefit Event** — an open event celebrating and supporting CONNECT’s most active creators.   
  
Take part in the opening event and earn **exclusive  creator rewards!**

  
**** Uploads must be submitted by December 31 to be eligible for the event.**

_** Eligibility is based on the initial upload date. Items first uploaded by_** _Dec. 31_** _remain eligible even if re-uploaded after review. Please note that reviews may take 2–3 weeks during the holiday period._  


_In accordance with game policy, only free items are currently supported. Paid options are under review._

![a79749bb267c43be9463414150ceccfc](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/bc462714126240ce9817aed6ad9d773b/images/a79749bb267c43be9463414150ceccfcSection%20%282%29.png)
